protocol.forward: median of achieved/commanded vx over the chosen-bounds 'fwd' segments in [0.75, 1.25]
protocol.turn: median of achieved/commanded wz over all chosen-bounds segments with a wz command (turn in place + forward-and-turn, m0_gate's tracking 'wz') in [0.75, 1.25]
protocol.straight_yaw_drift: |median achieved wz| over the chosen-bounds 'fwd' segments (wz command 0, vx 0.2-0.4) < 0.05 rad/s
protocol.falls: 0 falls (trunk tilt > 45 deg) over the 16 pad trials + 20 chosen-bounds runs + 20 training-bounds runs; push trials excluded (a push-recovery probe that knocks the duck over by design, reported separately)
protocol.pass: all four, on the primary body

speed.method: single process, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, plain scene, vx 0.3, 2000 control steps after 100 warm-up, 3 interleaved repeats, median
speed.note: the plan's 7,690 steps/s for the XML body was measured at load ~4.9

posthoc_exploratory.note: added after the verdict, not pre-registered, never gating; fixed lag (physics steps) on the primary semantics; lag 4 = variant bam_lag4
